skills.does: Convert an angle — degrees, radians, gradians, turns, arcminutes, arcseconds.
Convert an area — square metres, square feet, hectares, acres, square miles.
examples: how many square feet is 85 square metres

skills.does: Write a number in another base — 200 in base 7, 255 as hex, or 1011 back from binary. Any radix from 2 to 36.
Convert a file or storage size — bytes, kB, MB, GB, TB, and the binary KiB, MiB, GiB.
Convert fuel economy between litres per 100km, miles per gallon and kilometres per litre.
examples: convert 40 imperial mpg to l per 100km

skills.does: Convert a distance or length — millimetres, centimetres, metres, kilometres, inches, feet, yards, miles.
Convert a weight or mass — grams, kilograms, tonnes, ounces, pounds, stone.
Convert a number to Roman numerals, or read Roman numerals back as a number.
Convert a speed — miles per hour, kilometres per hour, metres per second, knots.
examples: how fast is 20 knots in km/h

skills.does: Convert a temperature between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin.
Convert a length of time between units — how long 210 minutes runs to in hours.
Convert a volume — millilitres, litres, teaspoons, tablespoons, cups, pints, quarts, gallons.
Spell a number out in English words, the way it is said aloud or written on a cheque.
Assemble a ?key=value query string from named parameters.
examples: build a query string from these parameters
make a query string with a space in the value
build a query with a repeated parameter

skills.does: Total, average, or find the smallest or largest value down one column of a table.
examples: highest value in the score column

skills.does: Compare two JSON documents and list the paths added, removed and changed.
examples: what was removed between these two versions

skills.does: Drop the rows of a table that fail a condition.
examples: keep only rows where amount is over 100
show me just the North region rows

skills.does: Squash nested JSON down to one level, every key a dot path.
Tidy JSON into readable indented form, or squash it onto one line.
Read one value out of a JSON document at a dotted path — pull settings.theme out of it.
examples: what is at a.b.c in this document

skills.does: Total or average rows per category, grouped by a shared value.
examples: group these rows by region and sum the amounts
count the rows in each category

skills.does: Read CSV text into rows and columns, detecting the header line.
examples:
parse this csv: name,amount
Ana,120
Bo,80
read a csv with a quoted comma

skills.does: Read key/value or INI-style settings text into structured data.
examples: parse an ini file with sections

skills.does: Read an existing markdown table back into rows of data.
examples: turn this markdown table into rows
read a table with alignment markers

skills.does: Break a link’s ?key=value pairs apart and say what each holds.
examples: break down the parameters in this url
parse a query with encoded values

skills.does: Cross-tabulate one column against another into a grid of cells.
examples: pivot amount by region and quarter
count rows by day and type
average sales by store and month

skills.does: Pick which columns of a table to keep, renaming them if you like.
examples: keep only the name and amount columns
pick the region column and rename it to area

skills.does: Change or add a value in a JSON document at a dotted path — update config.timeout to 30.
examples: set user.name to Bea in this json
add an email field to this json

skills.does: Sort the keys of a JSON object alphabetically, all the way down.
examples: sort the keys in this json

skills.does: Reorder the rows of a table by a column, changing nothing else.
examples: order by region then by q1

skills.does: Turn rows and columns back into CSV text, quoting anything that needs it.
examples: turn this table back into csv
write this out as csv, quoting the comma

skills.does: Draw rows and columns out as a markdown table, pipes and all.
examples: make a markdown table from this data
format as a right-aligned markdown table

skills.does: Pivot a table on its side, so rows become columns.
examples: flip this table on its side

skills.does: Rebuild deep nested JSON from keys that are already flat dot paths.
examples: rebuild nested config from dotted keys
turn indexed paths back into an array

skills.does: Move a date forward or back by a number of working days — three working days on from a Monday — skipping weekends and holidays.
examples: what date is 5 working days from 1 September 2026

skills.does: Move a date forward or back by days, weeks, months or years.
Count how old somebody is from their birthday.
examples: how old will a baby born 2026-06-15 be on 2026-12-25

skills.does: Count how many working days (Mon–Fri) fall between two dates you give. Does not know public holidays.
examples: working days between 1 September and 30 September 2026
how many business days from monday 2026-06-01 to friday 2026-06-05
business days in a full year 2026

skills.does: Convert a time from one time zone to another, using IANA zone names.
examples: what is 9am Tokyo in London on 2026-01-15
